text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and keeps you strong. Regular exercise, like walking or swimming, is also important for your heart and muscles. Don't forget sleep — most adults need seven to eight hours each night to feel fresh. Mental health matters too, so try to relax and share your feelings with friends. Finally, keep a good work-life balance: make time for rest and hobbies, not just work. Small healthy habits every day can make a big difference to your life.
